body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes blank chart rendering by updating `@object-ui/data-objectstack`’s `aggregate()` response parsing to correctly extract analytics rows from the API’s `{ rows }` / `{ data: { rows } }` envelopes, and adds unit tests to prevent regressions.

**Changes:**
- Extend `aggregate()`’s `rawRows` extraction to handle `{ rows: [...] }` and `{ data: { rows: [...] } }` response shapes.
- Add two unit tests covering both envelope variants and confirming measure-key remapping (e.g. `expected_revenue_sum` → `expected_revenue`).
- Update the changelog entry to document the follow-up fix for blank charts.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts | Adds `data.rows` / `data.data.rows` handling so analytics query results don’t incorrectly fall through to `[]`. |
| packages/data-objectstack/src/aggregate.test.ts | Adds test coverage for both analytics response envelopes and validates measure-key remapping still works. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the additional envelope-handling fix as part of the analytics aggregate entry. |
